text.p: Tropical cyclone 17P is a weak system with top winds near 35 mph. It is expected to move into Vanuatu during the next 12-18 hours. It should cause a few problems for shipping in the region due to squalls and rough seas. It should also cause locally heavy rain which may lead to some minor flooding.

Tropical Cyclone 18S, centered in the southern Indian Ocean near 26s/82.5e, is moving southwest at 16 mph. Top winds are 40 mph and will continue to weaken this period. This system will likely be dissipated by 12-18 hours. This system is only a threat to shipping and this threat will diminish with time.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
